strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: I-UG ikhuluma izilimi zase-Uganda, zesifunda, nezezivakashi zayo. Khetha eyakho; konke okunye kulandela.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: Uhlelo olulodwa oluqhathanisa amanani alo lonke uhambo emakethe yase-Uganda, luhlanganise uhambo lomgwaqo ukuze i-Prado ibize ingxenye yesine, luqashe imoto uma udinga ukufika kahle, futhi lubhukhe ipaki ngaphambi kokuba amaphepha aphele. Ukhokha ngendlela iKampala ekhokha ngayo: imali yeselula.
strings.doorRiderSub: Thatha isihlalo, qhathanisa wonke amahambo, hlela impelasonto.
strings.doorDriverSub: Sho lapho ukhululekile khona. Uhambo olukhokhelwe luyeza kuwe.
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Isibonelo v1 · lonke inani liyisilinganiso esivela endleleni eshicilelwe · ukukhokha kusebenza esibonelweni · ayikho insizakalo enelayisensi lapha
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Lonke uhambo olusemakethe, isikrini esisodwa, luhlelwe ngenani.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Okubiza ukukhetha kabi <small>umehluko wamanani kulolu hambo</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: I-Atlas · zonke izindlela zokuhamba, ithebula elilodwa <small>umoya, ibhasi, amanzi, isitimela, izimoto ze-Signature, nezindawo zokulala, neqiniso ngayinye</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Bhukha ku-UG lapho kunendlela, Shayela ngaphambili lapho ingekho, Isohlwini ukuze yaziwe, Iyeza kulokho okwakhiwayo. Amanani ayizilinganiso futhi ayasho.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Isiteshi sedijithali · izihlalo zigcwala kuqala, imoto ibe isiza
strings.stage.h2.pay_for_the_seat: Khokhela isihlalo. Imoto iza uma sigcwele.
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Njengesiteshi sematatu, imoto ihamba uma igcwele noma ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe. Kodwa lapha, ukhokha usendlini yakho, inani lesihlalo lehla njengoba abangani bejoyina, futhi umshayeli oyithathayo usevele washo ukuthi ukhululekile kulowo mgwaqo.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Lapho iziteshi zigcwala khona ngokushesha <small>Pulse · izihlalo ezikhokhelwe, ngedolobha</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Amabhasi kulo mgwaqo <small>enye indlela, eceleni kwesiteshi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Wonke umgwaqo unamabhasi futhi. Qhathanisa izikhathi zokusuka kubo bonke ababambe iqhaza, bona isiteshi osuka kuso, futhi ubhukhe ku-UG lapho umsebenzi amukela ukubhukha ku-inthanethi. Lapho engamukeli, siyakutshela futhi sikunikeze inombolo yokushayela, esikhundleni senkinobho engasebenzi.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Yonke imoto eqashiwe enomshayeli nalo lonke uhambo olwabelwene lunendlela yokubuya. Uma uhambo lokuya lubhukhiwe, izihlalo zokubuya ziyathengiswa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Faka uhambo lwakho, noma ubone inani lesihlalo <small>Pool · abangani bakho, inani langempela lomgwaqo lihlukaniselwe izihlalo</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Nikeza isihlalo, noma ubone ukuthi isihlalo kufanele sibize malini
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Uhambo olufakiwe lusesiphequluli kuphela uze ungene. I-Pool ilandela indlela efanayo: ama-akhawunti aqinisekiswe ngefoni, ingxoxo yohambo, nokulinganisa nhlangothi zombili, kanye namaqembu ukuze uhambe nabantu osuvele ubazi.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Zishayele ngosuku, nomshayeli ngehora, noma i-Signature uma ukufika kuyikho okubalulekile. Inani ngumuntu ngamunye uma nihlukanisa.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Thumela into. Noma ingakanani, noma ikuphi.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Bonke abathumeli edolobheni esikrinini esisodwa, behlelwe. Emaphandleni, iphasela lihamba esitolo semoto yesiteshi ngengxenye yesine yesihlalo, futhi ngesikhathi sokuvuna kube yi-minibus, i-pickup noma iloli enomshayeli.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Amanani abathumeli ayizilinganiso ze-UG ezivela endleleni eshicilelwe; u-8 to 8 eJinja ubizwa ngencwadi yomsunguli futhi inani lakhe liyisilinganiso. Iphasela eSiteshini yinani le-UG uqobo: ingxenye yesine yesihlalo kuleso siteshi, ekhokhelwa umshayeli kanye nezihlalo.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Ukungena epaki, amaphepha, imali yemoto, indawo yokulala, imali yokudla nomgwaqo, konke kubalwe kwizakhamuzi zase-Afrika yaseMpumalanga, abokufika abahlala lapha nezivakashi. Izakhamuzi zase-Afrika yaseMpumalanga zikhokha amanani ase-Afrika yaseMpumalanga.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Hlanganisa usuku lonke <small>Hustle Mode · ingxenye ngayinye ibalwe ngendlela eshibhile; isikhwama nezinhlelo kuyisibonelo</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: Isikhwama se-UG · imali yesibonelo, hhayi eyangempela
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Sho lapho ukhululekile khona, kanye. Yamukela izimoto ezigcwele.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Akukho ukufaka, akukho ukulinda esiteshini, akukho ukuncintisana. Ibalazwe lokukhululeka kwakho yikho kuphela okugcinayo: isizinda, ibanga, imigwaqo, amahora, nalokho ongakwamukeli. Uhambo olukhokhelwe lufika imali isivele iphakathi.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Lapho isidingo sivela khona kuleli sonto <small>Foresight · ukuvuna, imicimbi nezenzakalo, isonto ngaphambili, ngohlobo lwemoto</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Thembisa ukuba khona bese igebe livalwa kubo bonke. Ukuthemba kuboniswa ngasignali ngayinye; izinkathi ziyimithetho kuze kube yisivuno sokuqala esizifundisayo.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Ukuthemba kuboniswa ngasignali ngayinye; izinkathi ziyimithetho kuze kube khona uhambo olugcwele okufundwa kulo.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Iwebhusayithi yiyo uhlelo. Yifake, noma uskene ikhodi.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Isixhumanisi esisodwa ku-inthanethi nasefonini: i-akhawunti efanayo, iziteshi ezifanayo, noPhawu olufanayo esikrinini sasekhaya. Awuyi esitolo.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Skena ngekhamera. Ikhodi ivula sona lesi sixhumanisi; ngena ngenombolo efanayo bese konke kulapha.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Gibela. Yabelana. Qasha. Thumela. Imakethe yokuhamba yase-Uganda kubantu abanezindawo abaya kuzo nesabelomali abasihloniphayo.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Ukukhokha nge-Flutterwave · kuyisibonelo kuze kufakwe ukhiye wangempela
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Kubhukhiwe futhi kulandelelwa ku-UG. Umsizi uyisibonelo kulesi sibonelo.
strings.railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an: Nciphisa ukunyakazaAyikho i-animation yokuvula, azikho izinto ezindizayo
strings.railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_: Dweba umugqa ngaphansi kwezixhumanisiSonke isixhumanisi sinomugqa, hhayi umbala kuphela
strings.railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your: I-UG ilandela nezilungiselelo zesistimu yakho zokunyakaza nomehluko, isebenza nomfundi wesikrini, ingasetshenziswa ngekhibhodi yonke, futhi ilalela izwi ngenkinobho yemakrofoni noma nge-Cephable. Sitshele ukuthi yini engasiza: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Lonke idolobha elisebalazweni lingumgwaqo osuka eKampala futhi liyisiteshi salo. Lapho uhlelo lwendawo selusebenza, i-UG iyalunikeza uhambo lokugcina esikhundleni sokuzenza sengathi ikhona.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Amabalazwe avela ku-Felt. Umsebenzi wesimo sezulu uvela ku-Infrared City. Ukuzijabulisa kuvela ku-Tazama. Ukulawula ngezwi kuvela ku-Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Isengezo ngasinye sinendawo yaso nokhiye waso, kugcinwa kule divayisi uze ungene. Xhuma esisodwa bese izinkinobho ezifanele zivuleka ku-Pool, Hlola ne-Hustle Mode. Akukho okuphuma ku-UG ngaphandle kwesengezo osivulile.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Esincintisana nabo bafakwe ohlwini ngamabomu. Umgibeli othemba ukuqhathanisa ubuyela ku-pool nasekuqasheni.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: I-UG iyimakethe kuqala. Izinhlelo zokuhamba zithola ukubhukha okugcwalisiwe ngaphandle kwezindleko zokuthola amakhasimende. Izindawo zokuqasha zithola abaqashi abahloliwe. Amahhotela athola amaqembu afika ngosuku olwaziwayo. Abashayeli bathola umgwaqo ogcwele ngaphambi kokuhamba.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Abashayeli namanambaplate aqinisekisiwe, inkinobho yosizo ohambweni eyabelana ngendawo okuyo nomuntu omkhethile, izigqoko kuwo wonke amaboda okwabelwene, nerisidi kuyo yonke ishilingi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Ishumi ephesentini ku-pool, inani elilodwa lokufaka ohlwini ekuqasheni, ukukhokhelwa masonto onke ku-MoMo nge-Flutterwave, namakhasimende obungadingi ukuwakhangisela.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Izixhumanisi ezivula uhlelo lwakho lapho ulandwa khona nalapho uyiswa khona kugcwalisiwe. Asikaze sibonise inani esingalibalanga obala, futhi indlela ishicilelwe.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Ukuhumusha kwenziwa yi-UG futhi kwahlolwa okwesibili; ukuhlolwa ngumkhulumi wolimi lwebele kuvulekile. Amagama angekho abuyela esiNgisini.
strings.langNote: Izilimi ezingahlolwanga umkhulumi wolimi lwebele zibuyela esiNgisini lapho igama lingekho. Sisize siqede eyakho.

note: A full working isiZulu translation of the interface, plain and transactional. Carried for southern African travellers. Written by UG rather than by a first-language speaker; corrections are one tap away.
